purpose: Govern external scholarly literature retrieval, verification, evidence separation, citation traceability, and later manuscript integration without altering frozen AEGIS empirical evidence.
review_scope: reliability, uncertainty, calibration, and selective prediction
reproducible machine learning and experiment provenance
information integrity, threat-intelligence, and analyst decision-support framing

preferred: official standards or institutional publications where directly relevant
primary preprints only when peer-reviewed version is unavailable or chronology requires them
discovery_sources: Google Scholar or equivalent scholarly index
prohibited: secondary summaries used as substitutes for accessible primary papers

verification_policy: Every included reference must have verified title, authorship, year, venue/source, and stable DOI or canonical URL when available.
Claims attributed to a paper must be supported by that paper rather than inferred from its title.
Preprint and peer-reviewed versions must not be double-counted as separate scientific works.
Retractions, corrections, or materially superseded versions must be recorded when discovered.
External literature must remain distinguishable from AEGIS repository-derived evidence.
temporal_policy: Use foundational literature where scientifically necessary and recent literature where it materially reflects the state of the field; do not impose a recency cutoff that excludes seminal methods.
integration_policy: External literature may contextualize motivation, methods, related work, limitations, and future research.
External literature may not rewrite AEGIS frozen experimental values, statuses, thresholds, or dispositions.
Do not claim AEGIS outperforms prior work unless a valid comparable frozen evaluation supports that claim; none is authorized by this protocol.
Do not convert validation Macro-F1 into an externally comparable benchmark without verified protocol equivalence.
Keep NOT_SUPPORTED, NOT_COMPUTED, CHARACTERIZED, and FUTURE_WORK semantics unchanged.
